implemented_scope: Private Admiral business workspaces and optional ship-owned books in the appointed Captain Station.
storage: Device or Trade Winds for the Admiral. Server-backed ship scope for the Captain, with separate per-user draft recovery.
features: private backup and matching empty-workspace restore
flat job charge on quotes and invoices
search and paging for the full document list
numbering: Shared fleet invoice series where Tally is available. Ship Captain invoices require a fleet reservation.
authority: The Captain needs an active session, an accepted appointment and active membership for the exact ship, an eligible tool and a saved ship opt-in.
customer_experience: The Captain Station holds the editor. A Captain can deliberately share a document PDF.
househull: Estimator-operated. Planned HouseHull workspace is explicitly local and does not commission a vessel. Product conversion and measurement rules require future verified implementation.
finalization: Exact customer PDF is prepared before the guarded immutable snapshot is committed.
